realEchoCases.draft: You've just tuned your instrument. Now you're going to put it in motion, as a Projected Energy Bubble. From the top of your head, let a current begin. Out and down around your body, in through the soles of your feet, and up through you to the crown again. A loop, always moving, always returning. As it moves, it begins to spill outward. Some of it falling straight. Some spiralling clockwise. Some counterclockwise. Each one sits at its own depth, its own layer, so none of them cross. But together they pull against each other, like fibres in a woven cloth. Wherever they'd meet, they form small triangles instead, pointing in, pointing out. That's what makes it strong. Keep it moving. If any strand runs thin, there's always more behind it, the same rise and fall you've been breathing with the whole time. Let it keep building, layer over layer, until you can no longer pick out a single strand. What's left is a bubble, and you're standing inside it. This living field performs two functions. First. It holds and concentrates your own energy, so you can direct it as you need. Second. It protects you from outside energies, unless you consciously choose to let them in. Take a moment now to feel its strength and its softness. Feel how it moves with you. To recreate your PEBLE at any time. Inhale deeply, and picture the current starting again at the crown of your head. Exhale, and let it fall and spiral outward the way it just did. Your bubble will form again. To dissolve it, inhale, and draw the current back up into your crown, letting the strands unwind as they go.

Or simply observe and experience. Use this time however serves you. I'll call you when it's done. Return now to normal Focus 12. Calm and comfortable, back in Focus 12.

realEchoCases.draft: Before we go further, one more thing that's always yours to use. If the experience ever feels clouded, or fogged, or harder to hold onto than it should be, you have a technique for that. Think: clear skies. Clear skies changes the field around you the way it changes any weather here. What you hold in mind is what continues. Used this way, it dispels interference and lets the experience carry on, with less between you and it. If that isn't enough on its own, there's a second step. Send out a single, deliberate pulse — not force, coherence. It settles the field around you, and steadies whatever is underway so it can continue without interruption. And if you'd rather not continue at all, you always can eject. Return to Focus 1, and the channel closes behind you, at least for now. This is never a failure. It's a door, and it stays unlocked from your side. None of this is a sign of danger. It's a sign you're steering. Carry this with you as you go. Nobody, and nothing, can harm you here. They may try to make you believe they can — that belief is the only lever they have. The part of you doing the steering knows more than you can perceive right now, and isn't asking your permission to be capable. Trust it.
realEchoCases.name: clear-skies vs advanced-focus-10
realEchoCases.source: Once Focus 10 is familiar to you, you don't need the full count to return to it. Inhale deeply. As you hold your breath, think the number ten, inside a bright, moving circle. Exhale, and you'll be in Focus 10, just as you are right now. Returning is just as quick. Think the number one, and intend to be awake. Do this, and you'll be completely awake, both physically and mentally, refreshed, in every way. The more you use these, the faster and more natural they'll become.

realEchoCases.draft: To take another step along the path. I will guide you to Focus 3, the starting point of the Gateway Experience. I will count from 1 to 3 And when I reach three, your mind and brain will be much more in unison, much more coherent. Much more complete. I'm going to count now. One. Two. Three.
realEchoCases.name: climb-f1-f3 vs briefing-f3
realEchoCases.source: You're at Focus 3 now. In later sessions, Focus 3 is a brief signpost on the way to Focus 10. Here, for your first visit, simply notice this light relaxation and the more coherent pattern of mind and brain.

realEchoCases.draft: From Focus 10, you will move one step to Focus 11. The only available map is a secondary overview. It calls Focus 11 the Access Channel, but no tape or manual here establishes what the transition should feel like. Let the number mark the change, and let your own observation supply the account. Ten. Eleven.
hits: available map is a secondary overview
realEchoCases.name: climb-f10-f11 vs briefing-f11
realEchoCases.source: You are now in Focus 11. No tape or manual in this library describes this level. The available map is a secondary overview of uncertain origin, so hold its description lightly. That overview calls Focus 11 the Access Channel. It associates the level with directing physical, mental, and emotional functions, and with access to the Total Self. Treat that as a proposition to test, not a result to reproduce. Observe what is actually present for you, without forcing it to match the map. Remember what you notice. Your attributed account may confirm, amend, or reject what the overview says.

realEchoCases.draft: Now, from Focus 10, you will move into a different state of consciousness. That state is called Focus 12. Focus 12. Where your awareness moves far beyond the limits of your physical body. Far beyond physical perception. To reach Focus 12, all you need do is count slowly in your mind from ten to twelve. When you reach the number twelve, you will be in Focus 12. A state of expanded awareness. Let me guide you. Ten. Eleven. Your awareness is expanding, reaching outward, more and more. Twelve.
realEchoCases.name: climb-f10-f12 vs advanced-focus-12
realEchoCases.source: Return to Focus 12, and reinforce it. Let your consciousness expand even further, deeper, well beyond your five physical senses. In this expanded state, you're free to explore however you choose. Set new patterns for your life. Reopen a communication point with someone. Practice nonverbal communication. Or simply observe and experience. Use this time however serves you. I'll call you when it's done. Return now to normal Focus 12. Calm and comfortable, back in Focus 12.

realEchoCases.draft: Now, you will move from Focus 12 into another state of being. Focus 15. Focus 15 is the state of no time. A state not limited by time or space. Because the energy that you are is beyond time, it is not controlled by time, and it can move freely. To reach Focus 15 from Focus 12, all you need do is count up slowly in your mind to fifteen. Express the desire to be in no time, and you will move into that state. I will count for you now. Twelve. Thirteen. You are moving out of the area of time, more and more. Fourteen. You are moving into the state where time has no meaning. You remain calm and serene. Fifteen. You are now in Focus 15. The state of no time. Where time does not exist.
realEchoCases.name: climb-f12-f15 vs briefing-f15
realEchoCases.source: Rest here a moment. Let the absence of time settle around you.

realEchoCases.draft: From Focus 15, you will move through the count to Focus 18. The available secondary map associates Focus 18 with unconditional love energy. No tape or manual here establishes what the transition should feel like. Let the numbers mark the change. Observe the transition itself without trying to produce the description in advance. Fifteen. Sixteen. Seventeen. Eighteen.
realEchoCases.name: climb-f15-f18 vs briefing-f18
realEchoCases.source: You are now in Focus 18. No tape or manual in this library describes this level. The available description comes from public summary material, so hold it lightly. That material associates Focus 18 with working in unconditional love energy, cultivating it in yourself, and carrying it into daily life with those close to you. Treat that as a proposition to test, not a feeling you are required to produce. Observe what is actually present for you, without forcing it to match the description. Remember what you notice. Your attributed account may confirm, amend, or reject the available map.

realEchoCases.draft: From Focus 15, we continue the climb. The next state is Focus 21. The threshold between the physical and the non-physical. Count with me. Fifteen. Sixteen. Seventeen. Eighteen. Nineteen. Twenty. Twenty-one.
realEchoCases.name: climb-f15-f21 vs briefing-f21
realEchoCases.source: You are now in Focus 21. The way ahead has been cleared for your passing. There is little to see here. It is a transition. A quiet bridge. You need not linger.

realEchoCases.draft: You will move beyond Focus 21 as I count. Twenty-two. You are changing. Less aware of time and space, and more aware of this other state. So close to time and space, but not part of it. Focus 22. Relax, and remain calm, serene, and sure. You and your consciousness are in full control.
realEchoCases.name: climb-f21-f22 vs briefing-f22
realEchoCases.source: You are now in Focus 22. This area is heavily populated, though only a small part of those here are conscious the way you are right now. Some have altered their awareness through substances, or through injury — not fully conscious, their perception of the physical distorted. Others are millions of people in ordinary physical sleep. Only part of their awareness has come here. Most aren't in control of what they're experiencing — they're running on patterns pulled straight from physical life, so completely that nothing else exists to them right now. Dreams. Dreaming. You won't interrupt them if you move among them. You likely won't even perceive what they're dreaming — it belongs to each of them alone. You're in full control here, whether or not they are. Observe, if you like. You're always free to move on toward Focus 23.

realEchoCases.draft: We continue upward, to Focus 23. Twenty-one. Twenty-two. Twenty-three.
realEchoCases.name: climb-f21-f23 vs briefing-f23
realEchoCases.source: You are now in Focus 23. It is like a ghostly river around you. A slow drifting mist, with ripples and waves moving past at their own pace. Pass through. Continue.

realEchoCases.draft: As you move, remain fully conscious and under complete control. Before you is a tiny pinpoint of light. Look for it. When you perceive it, focus your attention on that speck of light. With your attention on the speck of light, move in the direction of that light. Twenty-four. Focus 24. The light is getting larger and larger. It is very bright, but you get used to it because it is familiar to you.
realEchoCases.name: climb-f23-f24 vs briefing-f24
realEchoCases.source: You are now in Focus 24. Ahead of you, a point of light. It's growing larger as you move toward it -- bright, but familiar, the kind of bright you get used to. The light is large enough now to move into. When you're ready, continue forward.
